estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands pouring clean rainwater from a small jug into the saucer under a potted Venus flytrap until about 2.5 cm of water fills it; the small mascot figurine sits on the wooden table next to the saucer
Close-up of a man's hands holding a small handheld TDS water meter dipped in a glass of water, next to a potted pitcher plant
Close-up of a man's hands mixing dark peat moss and white perlite in a plastic bowl for carnivorous plant soil
Close-up of a sundew plant with a new twisted deformed leaf and small green aphids on it
Purple and green Sarracenia purpurea pitchers in a plastic pot on a sunny windowsill; the small mascot figurine stands on the windowsill next to the pot
Venus flytrap with open red-edged traps in a pot on a bright windowsill
Round-leaved sundew with shiny dewdrops on its sticky hairs in a small pot
Nepenthes in a hanging pot with several pitchers dangling freely in the air
